title: VooPoo PNP-TW/DW Replacement Coils
description: This pack of five genuine replacement Voopoo PnP-TW DL coils represent Voopoo’s newest addition to their bestselling PnP coils range and are built to deliver the best DL (direct-to-lung) vaping experience with Voopoo’s newest kits and pods, such as the Voopoo Drag E60 and Voopoo Drag H80S and Voopoo PNP Pod II. Easy to install the Plug-and-Play design lets you simply push the coils into place in the pod. They are available in five resistances, ideally suited to High-VG sub-ohm, NIc Salt or 50/50 e-liquids: PnP-TW15 DTL Coil - 0.15ohm (55-70W) DTL (direct-to-lung) - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid PnP-TW20 DTL Coil - 0.2ohm (40-55W) DTL (direct-to-lung) - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid PnP-TW30 DTL Coil - 0.3ohm (28-36W) DTL (restricted direct-to-lung) - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid PnP-DW60 Coil - 0.6ohm (18-23W) RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) - Use Nic Salt or 50/50 E-Liquid PnP-DW80 Coil - 0.8ohm (12-16W) RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) - Use Nic Salt or 50/50 E-Liquid You can check the authenticity of this product with the scratch sticker on the box. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your pod or tank. 'Priming a coil' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with a dab or two of e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your coil, attached it to your pod or tank, and filled up with e-liquid, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
